about: Kaira Can Company Ltd, incorporated in 1962, makes tin containers and components for food, dairy, edible-oil and paint packaging, and rolled sugar cones and paper sleeves for ice-cream manufacturers. It has factories at Kanjari and Vithal Udyognagar, Gujarat. [1]
